text: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and former capital of the Vijayanagara Empire, known for historic temples and architecture beside the Tungabhadra River.
Hampi highlights include Virupaksha Temple, the Vitthala Temple Complex and Stone Chariot, Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stables, Queen's Bath and Hampi Bazaar.

Incredible India lists Jindal Vijayanagar Airport at Vidyanagar, Hubballi Airport and Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru as airport links, and Hospet Junction Railway Station as a nearby rail link.
Incredible India describes coracle crossings on the Tungabhadra as a way travellers cross the river. Confirm local availability and operating conditions on arrival.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Mysuru, also called Mysore, is known for its palaces, heritage structures and cultural traditions. It was the capital of the Kingdom of Mysore for centuries.
Mysuru's listed attractions include Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills, Jaganmohan Palace, Brindavan Gardens and Karanji Lake.
The Incredible India guide lists Mysore Airport and Mysuru Junction Railway Station. It also lists Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru as an airport link.
Mysuru's guide names Mysore Pak, bisi bele bath, chitranna, Mysuru masala dosa, ragi mudde, shavige bath and obbattu among local foods.
